source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue building mathematical machinery toward eventual attacks on the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. After formalizing and receiver-validating monotone Markov-number labels, common-ancestor/first-divergence structure, a local counterexample reduction, and a re-rooted subtree API, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the next algebraic prerequisite: exact formulas for the two immediate child Markov-number labels at an arbitrary oriented node. The new module defines the parent coordinate selected by each Boolean forward direction and proves that if M is the parent Markov number and u,v are the two non-back coordinates, the child labels are 3Mv-u and 3Mu-v. Their difference therefore factors as (3M+1)(v-u); positivity of M makes the factor positive, yielding exact strict-order and equality criteria for the two child labels. This is intended to feed future inequalities separating opposite child subtrees after the earlier first-divergence reduction. The module depends only on the validated Markov-number machinery and does not use or prove the open uniqueness conjecture. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and API and authored all Lean statements and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
